context.body: The divided waters stand as walls for Israel and later return over the pursuing force.
context.label: One medium, different outcomes

observations.body: The Scene begins with a command to go forward and a command to stretch a hand over the sea.
observations.label: Go forward

observations.body: The angel and pillar move from before Israel to behind them, standing between the two camps through the night.
observations.label: Cloud changes position

observations.body: A strong east wind drives the sea back, the waters divide, and Israel walks on dry ground between walls of water.
observations.label: Wind and dry ground

observations.body: Egypt enters after Israel; in the morning watch the army is confused, and the returning water covers chariots and horsemen.
observations.label: Pursuit and return

observations.body: Israel sees the LORD’s work, fears the LORD, and believes in the LORD and Moses.
observations.label: Israel responds

payload.posture: Follow command, cloud, wind, divided water, pursuit, returning water, and Israel’s final response in order.
payload.tension: The same divided sea becomes a path of dry ground for Israel and the place where the pursuing force is covered.
payload.title: Dry ground through divided water
